title: Chat Layout by @markoilico: Conversation modals designed for ClozerAI - an AI sales call assistant
notes:
Conversation modals designed for ClozerAI - an AI sales call assistant app. Main UI & UX patterns used: → Strong primary CTA that instantly draws focus to “Start Session” → Clear hierarchy that presents key info without breaking the call flow → AI-help buttons made prominent, visible exactly when it’s needed → Subtle call indicators (timer, recording), noticeable without distracting the salesperson

Designer: @markoilico. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
